sourceFindings.finding: 64 bounded slots are reserved before the durable dispatch reservation. Only the validated native receipt callback fills them; no eviction or caller-supplied ID import exists. The callback retains actual original scope metadata before journal recording and postflight checks. Capacity refusal precedes native dispatch and does not authorize a fresh ID or repeat POST.

Both resume overloads require an existing matching original journal state. Ordinary resume uses a durable ID or same-owner remembered acknowledgement; the opaque handoff additionally checks exact identity, ACK scope/byte count and any existing ID. Empty journal remains noRecordedAttachment; reserve() here is memory capacity only, never journal.reserve or native Attach.

The actual unchanged production journal poisons on append failure and refuses lookup/record while poisoned. It reopens only through canonical exact namespace/entry bytes and restrictive exclusive file/lock ownership. It is never unpoisoned by this adapter. Physical original-file continuity remains an owner responsibility; a custom protocol implementation alone cannot prove it.

Verification still requires original metadata -> complete byte count/digest -> metadata, exact UTF8 account/Space/object/file/immutable metadata, then durable .verified. Releasing memory occurs before the final current-authority and original task cancellation fence; no explicit async call follows that fence. Revoked delivery preserves durable verified identity for authorized read-only recovery.

The four-line factory change retains one attachment actor for the existing object/journal owner. Actual native workspace construction makes one ObjectCreator for its protected journal, and actual workspace close drains the session before closing that journal. No new account/session/authority owner is introduced; clientless test construction still refuses uploader manufacture. The eager attachment initialization also applies its exact UTF8 client/journal workspace guard before returning the production ObjectCreator.

Current af63 UI persists original caller intent before the Host reservation; Check has no URL or regenerated mutation ID. noRecorded retains unresolved intent. One original document claim spans the awaited native operation; captured native session, current mount and fresh read/write ACL remain required.
